For humans and agents: write in English for readers with limited attention.
TL;DR first; aim for 1–3 short bullets per section. Replace placeholders.

Link or collapse longer context. Never include secrets or private user data.
Agents: read AGENTS.md and the affected contract before implementing.
-->

## Summary

<!-- Explain the current problem and who benefits from solving it. -->

<problem and why it matters>

## Where

<!-- Name the affected command/workflow/module; link files and contracts if known. -->

- <affected area and relevant links>

## Desired outcome

<!-- Describe the result, with a concrete before → after example when useful.

- <observable change or deliverable>

## Acceptance criteria

<!-- Checkable outcomes define "done". Include meaningful rejection, failure,
or recovery behavior when relevant. Name platform evidence needed for OS claims.
Include the owning spec/scenario update if behavior changes. -->

- [ ] <verifiable outcome>

## Scope and risks

<!-- State boundaries and real constraints. Mention security, OS parity,
resource limits, or compatibility when affected; use N/A with a reason otherwise. -->

- **Out of scope:** <what this task excludes, or N/A with a reason>
- **Risks/constraints:** <known risk or constraint, or N/A with a reason>
